## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Example

For a behavior change, include a small before/after example or reproduction.

## Validation

List relevant commands and results, including unavailable tools or untested platforms. Documentation-only changes can say so.

## Limits and tradeoffs

Mention any changed semantics, compatibility costs, or performance tradeoffs. For a speed claim, include matching baseline options and raw measurements.
